gate_status_definitions.auto_mappable_candidate: High-readiness fact/text candidate with strong evidence and no conflict/manual-review blockers.
gate_status_definitions.suggest_mapping_only: Usable candidate that may receive mapping suggestions but requires human confirmation before XBRL generation.
gate_status_definitions.manual_review_required: Candidate or conflict group must be reviewed before any mapping attempt.
gate_status_definitions.blocked_from_mapping: Candidate must not enter automatic mapping.
gate_status_definitions.reference_only_or_context: Contextual heading/metadata/narrative support; not a mapped fact.

manual_review_reason_definitions.duplicate_conflicting_values: Same case/label has multiple value variants; no value can be chosen automatically.
manual_review_reason_definitions.duplicate_same_label_value: Same label/value appears more than once and should be reviewed for evidence/context.
manual_review_reason_definitions.exact_duplicate_suppressed: Candidate was suppressed as an exact duplicate in the #13S cleaned report.
manual_review_reason_definitions.date_or_year_label: Candidate label is a pure date, year, or generic period label.
manual_review_reason_definitions.year_header_row: Candidate appears to be a year/period header row rather than a fact.
manual_review_reason_definitions.heading_like_numeric_fact: Numeric row has a heading-like label and may need total/subtotal or section policy.
manual_review_reason_definitions.weak_label: Candidate label is missing, too short, generic, or otherwise weak.
manual_review_reason_definitions.weak_text_block_label: Text block has weak or missing label evidence.
manual_review_reason_definitions.ambiguous_statement_section: Candidate section is generic or questionable for mapping.
manual_review_reason_definitions.non_numeric_numeric_value: Numeric candidate value is not numeric.
manual_review_reason_definitions.sign_uncertainty: Negative or dash/zero values require sign/normalization policy.
manual_review_reason_definitions.current_prior_uncertainty: Current/prior values or year context are incomplete or uncertain.
manual_review_reason_definitions.subtotal_total_uncertainty: Total/subtotal meaning requires policy or confirmation.
manual_review_reason_definitions.text_block_boundary_uncertainty: Text block may be too short, too long, heading-only, or poorly bounded.
manual_review_reason_definitions.section_mismatch: Candidate row type appears inconsistent with its statement section.
manual_review_reason_definitions.suppressed_candidate: Candidate is retained only in audit trail and must not enter automatic mapping.
manual_review_reason_definitions.not_ready_candidate: Candidate readiness is not_ready or otherwise unsafe for mapping.
manual_review_reason_definitions.requires_manual_mapping_confirmation: Mapping suggestions are allowed only with later human confirmation.

rules: Do not include suppressed candidates in auto mapping input.
Do not include downgraded metadata/year/date candidates in auto mapping input.
Do not include conflict-review candidates in auto mapping input unless future human confirmation exists.
Do not map manual_review_required, blocked_from_mapping, or reference_only_or_context candidates automatically.

limitations: This does not prove production readiness.
Reference XML is not sent to any model.
No DB mutation, live model call, benchmark rerun, UI/API implementation, or production cutover is performed.
recommended_next_feature: Feature #13U - Manual-review queue UI/API planning before mapping cutover.
